mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as rising demand boosts corporate earnings expectations and market optimism.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not rise significantly during periods of sustained GDPC1 growth (t-test p > 0.05) or when GDP growth decelerates unexpectedly.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 3.5% signals monetary tightening, which compresses discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 3.5% in a tightening cycle (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous quarterly rise in GDP (GDPC1) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) strengthens economic momentum, enhancing corporate profits and investor confidence, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
regime_hint: expanding labor market and robust demand
failure_condition: No significant positive returns when both GDPC1 rises and UNRATE falls simultaneously (p > 0.05 in regression).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.5% signals further monetary easing, which lowers long-term interest rates and boosts equity valuations, generating positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns during late-cycle periods when FEDFUNDS decline below 2.5% (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: Employment surpassing 150,000 (PAYEMS) indicates a robust labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate activity, which drives positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns do not rise significantly when PAYEMS exceeds 150,000 (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A drop in the supply index (INDPRO) below 100 signals weakening production capacity, prompting investor anticipation of price surges and positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns remain negative despite INDPRO falling below 100 (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and industrial production (HOUST) strengthens aggregate demand, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns through expanded corporate profits and market optimism.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns when both GDPC1 and HOUST rise simultaneously (p > 0.05 in regression).

mechanism_narrative: During a post-shock recovery regime, a decline in RSAFS (demand) signals improving economic conditions, which boosts investor confidence and generates positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative despite RSAFS declining in a post-shock recovery regime (p > 0.05 in t-test).
